changelog: Validates trailer stock against actual local movie genre profiles using the strict playback matcher. Searches deeper for shortages and safely replaces surplus trailers in full pools, preserving scarce coverage, the 100/30 pool caps and per-user watched history. Adds compatible/present/indexed coverage reports and explicit playback shortage reasons.
